notes.title: Update #2: Secret Level!
notes.notes:
A secret level has been added to the game!

Not only that, but I also transferred the whole game to the latest framework, which took many more hours than anticipated. Now, there are also more settings available and an Easter egg page! 

Because this was a significant endeavour, lots of stuff broke along the way. If I missed fixing something, please report it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2608040/discussions/0/8059829743280537955/]here.[/url]

[h2]What's new[/h2]
[list]
[*] Secret level! 
[*] Easter Egg page
[*] Cat color setting
[*] Background color setting
[*] Revamped night mode setting
[/list]

Happy egg hunting! :)
Patrick
